title: BERL launches its new research website
summary: The redesigned BERL website integrates research themes, people, publications, research programs, news, and contact information into a single data-driven platform.

title: Hydrothermal pretreatment for emerging polymer waste streams
summary: BERL is exploring hydrothermal solubilization and pretreatment strategies to understand how polymer transformation can be linked with downstream biological conversion and resource recovery.

title: Data-driven modeling for anaerobic digestion systems
summary: A current BERL research direction combines full-scale anaerobic digestion data with machine-learning methods to improve process interpretation, prediction, and operational decision support.

title: Microbial biodegradation and enzyme profiling of polyester materials
summary: BERL is investigating microbial growth, extracellular enzyme activity, and polymer transformation to better understand biological degradation pathways for polyester-based materials.

title: Mineral-assisted control of organic matter transformation and nitrogen dynamics
summary: BERL studies how mineral phases and chemical conditions influence organic matter transformation, nitrogen partitioning, microbial succession, and stabilization processes.
